REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
THURSDAY - JUNE 5, 2025 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Recreation Services Division, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Recreation Services Division during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to recreation@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1254 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 5.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to recreation@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Recreation Services Division no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Recreation Services Division at (562) 916-1254 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

CITY OF CERRITOS
  MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
  OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  JUNE5, 2025

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.
2.  Pledge of Allegiance
  Commissioner DeLeon ted in the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  Roll Call

  PRESENT:  Commissioner Alex Camargo
  CommissionerCathy DeLeon
  Commissioner Jose Iglesias
  Vice Chair Pat Patnaik
  Chair Ileana Prado

  All Members of the Parks and Recreation Commission were declared present.

4.  Presentations
4A.  Presentations

  Recreation Services Administrator Jill Toda recognized Recreation Leader IV Esteban
  Almaraz and Recreation Leader IV Ashley Correia as Employees of the Month for April.

5.  Public Comments and Suggestions
  Teddy Lloyd spoke in support of the City’s actions in adding pickleball courts;
  suggested changing the hours of operation for courts at Liberty Park to earlier in the
  morning and later at night, adjusting lighting and spoke about courts in the City of La
  Palma

  Therewere no other public comments on this item.
  Ms. Toda noted that no action can be taken at this time, since the item is not on the
  agenda.

  Director of Community and Cultural Services Annie Hylton discussed the hours of
  operation for the new pickleball courts; noted staff is gathering information, on a trial
  basis, to assess dual uses (tennis and pickleball) and addressed Council direction to
  staff

6.  Consent Calendar

6A  Approval of Minutes – Thursday, May 1, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Parks and Recreation
  Commission Regular Meeting Minutes
   MOTION: Commissioner Iglesias moved to approve the Consent Calendar, as
  presented. Commissioner DeLeon seconded the motion, which carried 5-0.
7.  New and Old Business
7A.  Review and consideration of an informational review of the Spring Fling and Fireworks
  SpectacularCelebratingthe City’s 69th Anniversary held on April 26, 2025.

  Ms. Toda displayed a PowerPoint presentation with details of the Administrative
  Report.

  Discussionfollowed regarding scaling down the Community Spring Fling event and the
  possibility of adding a 5K event prior to the Community Spring Fling.

  The Parksand RecreationCommissionconcurred to ask staff to return with a report
  regarding the possibility of adding a 5K event prior to the Community Spring Fling.

  There were no public comments on this item.

  MOTION: Chair Prado moved to receive and file the report, as presented.
  Commissioner DeLeon seconded the motion, which carried 5-0.

7B.  Reviewand considerationof an informational review of the 2025 Women’sDay
  Luncheon held at the Cerritos Senior Center.

  Community Services Supervisor Jesse Zavala displayed a PowerPoint presentation with
  details of the 2025 Women’s Day Luncheon.

  Discussion followed regarding the annual event, participation by Cerritos residents and
  the success of that event and the Pen Pal Luncheon.

  Therewere no public comments on this item.

  MOTION: Chair Prado moved to receive and file the report, as presented. Vice Chair
  Pathakseconded the motion, which carried 5-0.

8.  Reports

8A.  Reportsfrom Designated Commission Staff Liaison

  Recreation Services Administrator Stefanie Linn provided an update on Recreation
  Services programs, classes, and activities.

  Discussionfollowed regarding the costs for summer camps and the need to add food
  trucks for the Let Freedom Ring Celebration.

  Mr. Zavala provided an update on Senior Services programs, classes, and activities.

  Membersof the Commissioncommented favorably regarding the programsoffered by
  the Cerritos Senior Center.

  Discussion followed regarding the excursion to Pageant of the Masters and to the
  Angel’s baseball game and notary services.

City of Cerritos  June 5. 2025
Parks and Recreation Commission Minutes  Page 2
 9B.  Reports from Parks and Recreation Commission Members

  Vice Chair Patnaik commented on a new article ranking parks; reported the City of
  Irvine was among the top ten and asked about metrics used in the City to evaluate its
  parks

  Ms. Hylton spoke about the City's parks and green space and noted that the City’s
  goals and objectives are defined in its General Plan.

  Commissioner DeLeon noted that when fields are not being used, they are not
  available for casual use; talked about being asked to leave when trying to casually use
  the baseball diamond; felt that presents a disservice to residents and stated she would
  like for the City to explore opening up field access to soccer and/or baseball fields to
  different kinds of uses.

  Ms. Toda addressedthe field allocation and reservation process and rates and
  explained the various user groups allowed.

  Discussionfollowed regarding distinguishing between an organized activity and
  individual uses.

9.  Adjournment
  The meeting was adjourned at 8:02 p.m.
